caption: The drawing depicts an old-fashioned metal lock mechanism with a key inserted into it. The lock has a rectangular, flat backplate with four screw holes, two visible on the left and one on the top right, and an additional irregular edge at the bottom right. The main body of the lock is comprised of several geometric components, including a horizontal sliding bolt and a circular rotating component, likely the mechanism for the key. The key is shown inserted into a slot at an angle, with a rounded handle featuring a hole in the center. The drawing is rendered in graphite or ink, using shades of gray and black to give depth and shadow to the mechanical details, set against a plain, cream-colored or off-white background. The artist’s signature appears in the bottom right corner.
title: Lock and Key
